scripts.build: npm run clean:build && tsc -b packages/core packages/cli apps/desktop apps/tauri-desktop && npm run desktop:assets
scripts.desktop:smoke: npm run build && npm run desktop:smoke:built
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build && npm run desktop:icons && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --dir
scripts.desktop:pack:win: npm run build && npm run desktop:icons && node scripts/prepare-win-sharp-runtime.mjs && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --win --x64 --dir -c.win.signAndEditExecutable=false
scripts.desktop:portable:win: npm run build && npm run desktop:icons && node scripts/prepare-win-sharp-runtime.mjs && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --win portable --x64 -c.win.signAndEditExecutable=false
scripts.desktop:zip:win: npm run build && npm run desktop:icons && node scripts/prepare-win-sharp-runtime.mjs && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --win zip --x64 -c.win.signAndEditExecutable=false
scripts.desktop:local:win: npm run build && npm run desktop:icons && node scripts/prepare-win-sharp-runtime.mjs && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --win portable zip --x64 -c.win.signAndEditExecutable=false
scripts.desktop:dist:win: npm run build && npm run desktop:icons && node scripts/prepare-win-sharp-runtime.mjs && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --win --x64
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/cli apps/desktop apps/tauri-desktop --pretty false
scripts.release:preflight: npm run release:hygiene && npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm audit --audit-level=moderate && npm run desktop:smoke:built
scripts.release:check: npm run release:clean && npm run release:hygiene && npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm audit && npm run desktop:smoke && npm run desktop:pack && npm run desktop:pack:win && npm run release:verify-artifacts && npm run release:verify-win-native
scripts.release:check:win-portable: npm run release:clean && npm run release:hygiene && npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm audit && npm run desktop:smoke && npm run desktop:local:win && npm run release:verify-artifacts && npm run release:verify-win-native && npm run release:manifest && npm run release:verify-manifest
scripts.release:check:win: npm run release:clean && npm run release:hygiene && npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm audit && npm run desktop:smoke && npm run desktop:dist:win && npm run release:verify-artifacts && npm run release:verify-win-native
